semantic_explanation.dtall_semantics: DtAllInfo stores AddValues at the current pre-increment TimeStep with final dt; last row plus Dtf reaches the final saved time.
semantic_explanation.clamp_semantics: Run.out provides only aggregate clamp count; no per-row clamp location is inferred.
